svg.title: Perlite mines of North America and routes from the Babidanchi Mine
svg.desc: Map of the western United States and northern Mexico showing the perlite mines operating according to the USGS in 2019, the Babidanchi Mine in Sonora, and the highway routes to the Agua Prieta–Douglas and Ciudad Juárez–El Paso border crossings and to Hermosillo and Guaymas.
